note: Where a region's dated regime bands came from. `seeded:defranceschi-sovereignty` means the bands were taken from the Defranceschi family archive's own sovereignty.json, so for those regions the Atlas is partly the archive's research coming back and must not be cited as an independent confirmation of it; the Atlas added `filedUnder` and the notes. `unknown` means the region was written in the same first batch as the Defranceschi ground and nobody has checked. `not-recorded` (the default, for every region not listed) means this file does not say, which is not the same as independent. Source of the list: the family-sites coordination session's audit of 18 Oct 2026 and the region file's own note.
